references.text: States the total number of cities to be given to the Levites: forty-eight cities with pasturelands, corresponding to the final count in Joshua 21:41
First Chronicles repeats the list of the Levitical cities and confirms the forty-eight cities given to the Levites among the tribes of Israel
God's original command to Moses to give the Levites cities with pasturelands from the inheritance of the people of Israel
Laws concerning the Levitical cities and their pasturelands, establishing their permanent property rights
Explains that the Levites received no inheritance in the land, only cities to live in along with pasturelands for their livestock
